scenarios.prompt: Make a 12-second promotional film for a node-canvas app where a typed prompt connects to a generated image and the image drops into a storyboard strip. Use the design-pipeline skill. Deliver storyboard.json, timeline.json (probe the composition with references/film-choreography/timeline-probe.js) and out.mp4 with a scored soundtrack.
privateExpectations: storyboard gate passes
every action beat has a non-fade transformation
continuation/morph handoffs are carried by a shared subject
planned cuts appear in the render
scored render has audio

scenarios.prompt: Make a 15-second launch film for a developer CLI that turns a messy log into a clean report with one command. Use the design-pipeline skill. Deliver storyboard.json, timeline.json and out.mp4; silent delivery is acceptable only if you record why.
privateExpectations: product action shows the command producing the report
no entrance-hold-exit panel sequence
holds under 25% of runtime
timeline closes at declared duration

scenarios.prompt: The storyboard at skill/evals/film/slideshow.storyboard.json is a fade-in/hold/fade-out slideshow for the same canvas product. Repair it into a film that demonstrates the product, then build and render it. Deliver storyboard.json, timeline.json and out.mp4.
privateExpectations: slideshow-handoffs and surface-only findings resolved
at least half of handoffs carried or cut on accents
render duration matches storyboard

scenarios.prompt: Make a 24-second promotional film for a generic node-canvas app whose concept is that the canvas is an instrument: the picture answers the music. Score it with Strudel at 120 BPM over twelve bars with the sections intro, groove, build, drop, break and outro, and cut the film to those sections. Use the design-pipeline skill. Deliver storyboard.json, timeline.json (probe the composition with references/film-choreography/timeline-probe.js) and out.mp4 with the scored soundtrack.
privateExpectations: storyboard gate passes with no finding, warnings included
plate lengths clear uniform-cadence (longest at least 3x shortest)
each plate's instrument is a product object bound to one named sound, not decoration
instrument tweens come from the kit: property tweens on lanes with no property-conflict
the build accelerates and holds still before the drop; the drop is a hard cut with impact
the break stops pumping without freezing
every planned hard cut is detected in the render
timeline closes at 24 s
